method.mask_source: Ultralytics retina_masks=True masks.data full image >0.5; never masks.xy
method.matching: Hungarian maximum total bbox IoU, drop pairs below0.3; recall computed independently at0.5; no mask-IoU oracle selection
method.pck: Euclidean raw-pixel error / GT polygon-bbox diagonal <=0.1, misses count as failures
method.withinAnnotatedRegion: Point-in-annotated-bbox strict proxy; reference patch is not necessarily a full physical-part mask; misses count as failures
method.null_reference: Unconfirmed/unknown/occluded, not necessarily physically absent; no zone false-positive rate is inferred
method.gating: Model-candidate and Android-v1 single-equipment zone policies reported separately; full-resolution mask tolerance approximates native RLE256 geometry
method.orientation: Encoded pixel orientation via PIL RGB, no EXIF transform; images passed as BGR arrays
method.limitations: AI-assisted approximate annotations; still-image metric only; no temporal/AR/device performance claim
